key_insight: Conditional thermal states offer a route to enhanced quantum thermometry, and this work demonstrates their preparation on few-qubit quantum hardware.
engineering_relevance: Preparing these states on gate-based devices provides a practical building block for quantum thermodynamics and precision temperature sensing.
method: Condition thermal states on an accessible measurement pointer basis.
Prepare few-qubit states across a range of temperatures on IonQ cloud hardware.
Measure sub-quantum Fisher information using a constant-depth circuit without tomography.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports hardware preparation across multiple temperatures and sub-quantum Fisher information measurements to assess thermometric advantage, but gives no numerical results.
watch_item: The demonstration is limited to few-qubit systems, and sub-quantum Fisher information is only a lower bound on quantum Fisher information.
paper_title: NISQ Preparation of Conditional Thermal States for Precision Thermometry
